text: THE DBIM DESIGN'S ABOUT US FOLLOWS MEITY AND THE DBIM MANUAL, AND OUR TEAM DRAWS THE DEPARTMENT'S REFERENCE TREE. About Us now runs in MeitY's order (the DBIM benchmark), the same as the DBIM Figma file: a Vision box, then an introduction, Mission, Objectives as numbered cards, Functions as a numbered list, Organisational Set-Up, the Citizen Charter and Organisation Chart, and the longer records (Brief History, Bureau Head-Wise Allocation of Work, Former Secretaries, Sector-Wise Detailed Information) as rows that open in place. The Department publishes no vision, mission or objectives, and DBIM 3.0 §A.5.1.1 asks for all three, so each shows as a marked placeholder (`data-pending`) until the Department supplies it. Document dates print day-first (DD.MM.YYYY), per checklist item 27. The Our Team chart follows the reference tree: the Union Minister above, and the two Ministers of State side by side beneath, joined by a bar just above their headshots, with headshots round on white. The Secretary level is gone from the chart; the Secretary still heads the first office table.
